metrics_finding.finding: payment-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization decreased and error rate remained the same.

evidence_summary.summary: Payment service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization decreased and error rate remained the same.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor payment-service CPU utilization and adjust resource allocation as needed.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to an increase in CPU utilization of the payment service, which may have been caused by a resource-intensive process or a sudden spike in traffic. Further investigation is needed to determine the exact cause and suggest a fix.
report_text.hi: इस घटना के पीछे माना जाता है कि यह भुगतान सेवा की CPU उपयोगिता में वृद्धि हुई है, जो संभवतः एक संसाधन-आधारित प्रक्रिया या ट्रैफिक में तेजी से वृद्धि के कारण हो सकती है। औरर्निंग निर्धारित करने के लिए अतिरिक्त जांच आवश्यक है।
